verses.text: This will be my third visit to you. The Scriptures say, "Every matter must be proved by two or three witnesses."
I already warned you when I was with you the second time. Now I warn you again while I am away. When I come back, I will not spare those who sinned before, or any of the others.
You want proof that Christ speaks through me. He is not weak in dealing with you. He is powerful among you.
It is true that he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, but now he lives by God's power. We too are weak in him, but by God's power we will live with him to deal with you.
Look closely at yourselves to see if you are living in the faith. Test yourselves. Do you not know that Jesus Christ is in you? Unless, of course, you fail the test.
And I hope you will see that we have not failed the test.

We pray to God that you will not do anything wrong. We do not pray this so that people will see we have passed the test. We pray it so that you will do what is right, even if it looks as though we have failed.
We cannot do anything against the truth. We can only work for the truth.
We are glad when we are weak and you are strong. And we pray that you will become complete.
That is why I write these things while I am away. Then when I come, I will not have to be hard on you when I use my authority. The Lord gave me this authority to build you up, not to tear you down.
Finally, brothers and sisters, be full of joy. Work to be complete. Take comfort. Agree with each other. Live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.
Greet each other with a holy kiss.
All God's holy people here send you their greetings.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the friendship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you. Amen.
